_doc: Hand fit of the downloaded gun models (T-089, UPDATE_05 section 2), read by WeaponGLB on top of models.json. Rig space everywhere: metres, barrel along -Z, +Y up, origin at the right-hand grip. Per weapon: extra_rot [deg xyz] and extra_offset [m] after the models.json normalisation (the trigger lands 8 mm ahead / 6 mm below the origin by default), scale (overrides native.scale), grip_native (the pack-space point that becomes the origin instead of the trigger), pivots {Part: [x,y,z]} (hinges for Cover / Barrels / Cylinder, the bolt axis for Bolt), parent {Part: Parent} (the Webley cylinder under its barrels), rename {node: Part}, hide [node], borrow {Part: {asset, node, offset}} (a part from another converted asset), muzzle / sight_rear / sight_front / left_hand [x,y,z], sights_on (the group the sights ride on; the Slide by default when there is one), lh_axis z|y, lh_radius, grip_r [x,y,z], grip_lean deg, grip_r_radius, port [x,y,z], bore, empty {Part: [x,y,z]} (an empty node for a part the reload expects but the pack lacks), scope {y, z0, z1, mag} (a procedural scope on an iron-sighted model), kit_offset (the M1911's hand-fitted attachments shifted onto the OGA pistol), stock_share (the rear share of the length the sight scan skips), shader {wear, grime, scratches, grain_scale, seed, bluing [r,g,b], wood {material: 0..1}}. frost_by_map: the rime uniform per map id (WeaponShader).
